name: Trinisaura
sum: A lightly built, bipedal Antarctic ornithopod of about 1.5 m from the late Campanian of James Ross Island.
wsnote: About 1.5 m for the only known skeleton, a subadult.
holotype: A single incomplete postcranial skeleton with several vertebrae, a partial pelvis and a nearly complete right hindlimb, from James Ross Island (specimen number not read).
biology: Lightly built and bipedal, with long legs built for running and a rigid tail; its slow growth rate may be an adaptation to Antarctic conditions.
author: Coria et al. 2013

sources.text: R. A. Coria, J. J. Moly, and M. Reguero, S. Santillana, S. Marenssi. 2013. A new ornithopod (Dinosauria; Ornithischia) from Antarctica. Cretaceous Research 41:186-193
